items.text: Thank you to all of our new players! The launch has been exciting for all of us here at Team Backpack! It has gone very well and we're super happy with the feedback that we've received!
We've been listening to you and we already have several hotfixes planned for the next few days. We're starting with the biggest issues:
Updated fonts for Korean and Japanese
Fixed an issue that caused the Town save file to be lost
Fixed a translation issue that said "Translation not found for key 'Any'" in some research menus
We really appreciate your kind words and honest feedback!

releases.displayName: Backpack Hero Mod Support and CR8 Update!

items.text: Backpack Hero's official mod support is now live on the main branch of the game! 🎉
Simply select "Mods" from the Main Menu and you can add in tons of new items!
One of my favorites is the mod from The Farlands Workshop!
You can easily add the mod to your game by subscribing to it on the Steam workshop 🔨
I'm also a huge fan of the Plush Mod! Definitely worth checking it out!
If you want to learn more about creating your own mods, check out the documentation HERE.
That's not all for this update! We have several new things too!
Major changes to CR8! He has all new items, curses, relics, and an overheat mechanic that allows for some wicked new combos, but prevents some of the simpler infinites!
CR8 "Gear" builds. These are like cleavers, but for our robot pal!
The Cursed Forge! Add powerful new effects to your items at the cost of a permanent penalty applied to them! (Old forges are still there)
Many new items including Pandora's Box!
Buffed relics! More of the old relics will be added back in shortly!
New sound effects and animated backgrounds!
The Tusk doesn't effect CR8 components!
Improved options and credits screen! Kickstarter supporters can find their names more easily!
Many, many bug-fixes. We're sorry Coral wasn't working properly!
DISCORD
TWITTER
TIKTOK
REDDIT
Bug fixes from the last update!
Updated translations - specifically Korean and Chinese
Fixed a glitch where the cotton didn't save properly
Fixed a glitch where destroying multiple hazards would trigger end-of-combat effects multiple times
Fixed a glitch where item spaces could be improperly saved leading to CR8 charges being deactivated
You can no longer move on the map while viewing events or the options menu (should fix some associated glitches)
Fixed a glitch with item-creation items. Should be able to use coral and old-log appropriately now.
You can no longer "fire blank energy" after reorganizing or losing energy as CR8. The energy puff will just go away - ending your turn
Improved a delay when you have lots of items in your inventory that was effecting some players
Added another safe-guard to prevent out-of-alignment loading
You can no longer drag items while viewing options and other pop-ups
Small hotfix in anticipation of moving Twitch integration to the main branch!
Changes
New pouch design for the pets!
Update translations
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where Pet pouches could disappear after loading
Fixed a bug where the curse display did not reset properly after visiting a healer and cleansing curses

releases.displayName: Twitch Integration updated on the Testing Branch

items.text: Twitch integration is available now!
Dynamite and Clean Burn are now available in standard item drops
Sorry we cursed everyone! We heard you cursing the new system and we are working to resolve the difficulties!
Here are the changes we implemented!
Added the Little Lamp
Added the Clean Burn
Added the Dynamite
Enemies will give you a curse status effect and you can remove the status effect before combat ends to avoid curses
When cursed, you get a choice of 3 cursed items to take
You can not get more than 4 of your combat rewards replaced with curses
There is a curse-counter next to your gold with an additional tooltip
Lantern can be used twice
You cannot use lanterns on already cleansed curses
Bats will never do more than 1 malady and their vampire attack is reduced
Fire Geckos will never add 3 fire hazards
Fire will not spread until the end of the turn
The Seer will not curse on its first turn
The Dark Lady will apply Malady less frequently
Charmed Bracelet Legendary -> Uncommon 1 -> 0 energy -5 health on use
Evil Hand only adds rage when an item is destroyed
Cursed Sap now discards with other saps
Fixed a glitch with the Tutorial
Malediction creates only 2 maladys - not 3
Enemies will not attempt to curse the player if the player has received a curse this combat
Fixed save-games with Pochette (any old corrupted saves should be corrected too)
Fixed a glitch with the particles of the brick arrow
Fixed a glitch with the item atlas
Fixed a glitch with the Begonia Carving
Enemies will not use hazards OR curses when in Endless Dream
